name: saga
description: Temporal's saga sample (openAccount) as a certified machine: four steps in order; a failure compensates what succeeded before it, last first.

createAccount.why: open the account (the sample's activity, unchanged)

addAddress.why: register the postal address (the sample's activity, unchanged)

addClient.why: register the client (the sample's activity, unchanged)

addBankAccount.why: connect the bank account (the sample's activity, unchanged)

accountId.description: the account's id; a second start for the same account attaches to the first run

unstoppable.creating_account: a step is in flight: the saga ends by its own outcome or compensation
unstoppable.adding_address: a step is in flight: the saga ends by its own outcome or compensation
unstoppable.adding_client: a step is in flight: the saga ends by its own outcome or compensation
unstoppable.adding_bank: a step is in flight: the saga ends by its own outcome or compensation
unstoppable.undo_client: compensating: stopping would leave the account half undone
unstoppable.undo_address: compensating: stopping would leave the account half undone
